name: gq-corporate-income-tax
description: Corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) in Equatorial Guinea for tax year 2026 under Ley 1/2024 General Tributaria. Covers the 25% rate, the 1.5% Cuota Minima Fiscal, who is liable, the taxable base, losses, interest limits, incentives for new companies and investors, the annual Declaracion Estadistica y Fiscal, audit report thresholds, payment dates, withholding and penalties. Use for questions such as what is the company tax rate in Equatorial Guinea, when is the DEF due, how does the minimum tax work, how long can losses be carried forward, and do new companies get relief. Applies to SA, SAS, SARL, cooperatives, partnerships, branches and public companies. Oil and mining have added rules.
